## 13:7 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Then-I-dug in-the-Euphrates, as YHWH commanded-me, and-I-took the-waistband from-the-place where I-had-hidden-it, and-behold, the-waistband was-ruined — it-was-profitable for-nothing. |
| LOGOS | Then I dug up the waistband from the place by the Euphrates where I had hidden it, and behold, the waistband was ruined. It was good for nothing. |
| PNEUMA | Then I went back to the Euphrates and dug up the waistband I had hidden. It was ruined — totally useless. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
